frontmatter.name: ponytail-audit
frontmatter.description: Quality audit of a whole repo: bugs, security holes, what breaks under real load, risky code without tests, slow paths, and what to delete, merge or split. Ranked, each finding explained in plain English. One-shot report, changes nothing. Use for "audit this codebase", "review the whole repo", "find bloat", "what can I delete", /ponytail-audit.

frontmatter.name: ponytail-gain
frontmatter.description: Show ponytail's measured savings (code, cost, speed) from the benchmark. One-shot display. Use for /ponytail-gain, "what does ponytail save", "ponytail impact".

frontmatter.name: ponytail-review
frontmatter.description: Quality review of a change: is the logic right, is it safe, does it hold under real load, is risky code tested, is it fast enough, and is every line needed. Reads the connected code, not only the diff. Each finding is explained in plain English. Use for "review this", "code review", "review the last commit", "review my PR", "is this over-engineered", /ponytail-review.

frontmatter.name: ponytail
frontmatter.description: Lazy senior dev mode: the smallest change that fully solves the task, and a reply a busy human understands in one read. Use on any coding task (writing, fixing, refactoring, reviewing, choosing dependencies) and when the user says "ponytail", "be lazy", "simplest solution", "yagni", or complains about over-engineering or bloat. Levels: lite, full (default), ultra.

frontmatter.name: ponytail-debt
frontmatter.description: List every `shortcut:` comment (and older `ponytail:` ones) as a debt ledger. One-shot report, changes nothing. Use for "ponytail debt", "what did ponytail defer", "list the shortcuts", /ponytail-debt.

frontmatter.name: ponytail-help
frontmatter.description: Quick reference for ponytail levels, skills and commands. One-shot display. Use for /ponytail-help, "ponytail help", "how do I use ponytail".

nodes.label: showView()
nodes.rationale: Single-page router: toggles .view.active by id 'view-<id>' and lazily calls the per-view render function.

nodes.label: T translations (EN/AR)
nodes.rationale: i18n dictionary keyed by data-i18n attributes; Arabic switches dir to rtl.

nodes.label: /api/claude proxy endpoint
nodes.rationale: Browser calls a same-origin /api/claude proxy rather than Anthropic directly, keeping the API key server-side.

nodes.label: COPILOT_SYSTEM prompt
nodes.rationale: System prompt embeds a CRM data snapshot and asks for <120 words replies suited to being spoken aloud.

nodes.label: esc()
nodes.rationale: HTML-escape helper applied to Claude replies and user text before innerHTML injection (XSS defense).

nodes.label: VOICE_ROUTES keyword map
nodes.rationale: Local keyword routing avoids an API round-trip for navigation commands.

nodes.label: setScript() AI script router
nodes.rationale: Selects script tier (high/medium/low) from lead score and intent branch (buyer/investor/tenant), in current language.

nodes.label: Bilingual EN/AR support
nodes.rationale: Mockup targets UAE real estate: Arabic RTL layout, Arabic scripts and objection handlers alongside English.

nodes.label: Handoff-to-human logic
nodes.rationale: Cash buyer + specific area + 6-week timeline triggers system HANDOFF message which reveals handoff alert; routes to human specialist Sarah Ahmed with call data transferred.

nodes.label: Score routing tiers (80+/50-79/0-49)
nodes.rationale: High 80+: push to viewing/handoff immediately; Medium 50-79: qualify, send shortlist, book callback; Low 0-49: soft discovery, capture WA/email, nurture.

nodes.label: AIEngine module
nodes.rationale: Explainable, rule-based logic (not mock data) for scoring, intent NLP, NBA ranking and orchestration.
